## PANCREATITIS
[Oral step-down treatment](orzid2-gmenu-abx-step-down-treatment)
Antimicrobials are not indicated for uncomplicated pancreatitis.
In cases of necrotizing pancreatitis without infection, antimicrobial
prophylaxis does not improve patient outcomes. Antimicrobials increase the risk
of fungal superinfection and should not be used.
Antimicrobials are indicated for cases with pancreatic abscess, infected
pancreatic pseudocyst, or infected necrotic pancreas (phlegmon). The diagnosis
of infection can be difficult and may require aspiration. Consultation with
Gastroenterology and/or Infectious Diseases is encouraged.
## _______________________________________________________________________________
## Uncomplicated pancreatitis
No antimicrobials are indicated.
## _______________________________________________________________________________
## Pancreatic abscess, infected pancreatic pseudocyst, or infected necrotic
## pancreas (phlegmon)
## Duration of antimicrobial therapy
Total duration of antimicrobial therapy is typically 2 to 4 weeks
## Treatment
[Piperacillin-tazobactam 3.375 gm IV q6h [R]](psjizid-pip-taz-3-375-gm-iv-q6h-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro)
< OR >
[Meropenem 1 gm IV q8h [R,O]](psjizid-meropenem-1gm-iv-q8h)
Alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)
[Levofloxacin 500 mg IV q24h [R,DI] < AND > metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]](orz-set-abx-levofl-500mg-iv-q24h-metronidazole-500-mg-iv-q8h)
